queue.title: Weekly US rail freight climbs 4.7% as intermodal surges 8.3%
queue.excerpt: U.S. rail traffic rose 4.7% for the week ending November 21 from a year ago, the Association of American Railroads said, as intermodal volume again drove gains. Containers and trailers improved 8.3% compared with the same week in 2025, while commodity carloads edged up 0.5%.

queue.title: Reefer Produce Report: Thanksgiving week rates climb in Texas, Washington and Florida as California eases 3%
queue.excerpt: California produce rates eased 3% week over week for Thanksgiving week, while South Texas crossings gained 10%, Washington 8% and Florida 12%, according to USDA. Against last year, every one of the 57 lanes with a year-ago match is higher, and the average is +44%.
